concerns.text: Tasks T050 and T051 are tagged to [FR-017], but the spec.md Functional Requirements list ends at FR-016. There is no FR-017 defined in the spec to cover the 'Slow Takeoff' analysis. This represents a missing requirement in the spec for the work planned in tasks, or a stale/invalid tag in the tasks.

FR-016 mandates correcting for selection bias (detection efficiency). Task T032 implements a fallback to 'uniform weighting' if LVK files are missing. While this allows the pipeline to continue, the task description does not explicitly map to the requirement of 'correcting' the bias when data is missing (which is impossible), nor does it clearly tag the limitation logging (T039) as the fulfillment of the requirement's intent to document the constraint. The coverage of FR-016 is ambiguous regarding the 'missing data' scenario.

Tasks T050 and T051 reference 'FR-017' which does not exist in the spec. This is a stale/invalid tag. The tasks should either be re-tagged to a valid US (e.g., US-2c) or the spec must be updated to include FR-017 if this scope is ratified.
